name: Ingrit
summary: Ingrit is a trend following EA that uses moving average crossovers and momentum indicators to identify and ride market trends. It enters positions when short-term moving averages cross above long-term ones with confirming momentum signals, and exits on trend reversal or stop conditions. The EA incorporates trailing stops and risk management rules to protect capital.
summary_zh: Ingrit是一个趋势跟踪EA，利用均线交叉和动量指标来识别并追随市场趋势。当短期均线穿越长期均线且动量信号确认时开仓，在趋势反转或止损条件下平仓。该EA集成了移动止损和风险管理规则以保护资金。
strategy_analysis: Ingrit EA的核心策略是基于均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统，通过快速均线与慢速均线的金叉和死叉来判断趋势方向。入场条件要求均线交叉信号得到动量指标（如MACD或RSI）的确认，避免虚假信号。出场条件包括反向交叉信号、固定止损和移动止损三重保护机制。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例计算方式，确保每笔交易的风险可控。资金管理方面设置了最大持仓限制和每日亏损上限，防止极端行情下的过度亏损。整体策略逻辑清晰，但在震荡市中可能产生较多虚假信号导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of Ingrit EA is a trend following system based on moving average crossovers, using golden cross and death cross of fast and slow moving averages to determine trend direction. Entry conditions require MA crossover signals to be confirmed by momentum indicators such as MACD or RSI to avoid false signals. Exit conditions include triple protection: reverse crossover signals, fixed stop loss, and trailing stop mechanisms. Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or proportional calculation based on account balance to ensure controllable risk per trade. Money management incorporates maximum position limits and daily loss caps to prevent excessive drawdowns during extreme market conditions. The overall strategy logic is clear, but it may generate numerous false signals in ranging markets leading to consecutive losses.
pros: 趋势行情中盈利能力较强，能捕捉较大波段
三重出场机制（反向信号+止损+移动止损）提供良好保护
参数可调性高，适合不同市场和时间周期优化
集成了动量确认过滤，减少虚假信号入场
资金管理规则限制了极端风险暴露
pros_en: Strong profitability in trending markets, capable of capturing large price swings
Triple exit mechanism (reversal signal + stop loss + trailing stop) provides solid protection
High parameter adjustability suitable for optimization across different markets and timeframes
Integrated momentum confirmation filter reduces false signal entries
Money management rules limit extreme risk exposure
cons: 震荡市中表现不佳，容易产生连续虚假信号亏损
固定止损未考虑市场波动率变化，可能过于刚性
缺乏交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
仓位管理较为简单，未采用ATR动态调整
未包含点差过滤，高点差环境下盈利能力下降
cons_en: Poor performance in ranging markets, prone to consecutive false signal losses
Fixed stop loss doesn't account for market volatility changes, may be too rigid
Lacks trading session filter, may produce unfavorable fills during low liquidity periods
Position sizing is relatively simple without ATR-based dynamic adjustment
No spread filter included, profitability degrades in high spread environments
improvements: 添加ATR动态止损和仓位管理，适应不同波动率环境
增加震荡市识别过滤器（如ADX），在非趋势行情中减少交易
加入交易时段和点差过滤，提升成交质量
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss and position sizing to adapt to varying volatility environments
Introduce ranging market detection filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce trading during non-trending conditions
Implement trading session and spread filters to improve execution quality

risk_points: 固定止损在高波动时段可能过小导致频繁止损
缺乏新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓
震荡市中连续虚假信号可能造成累计亏损
未检查账户保证金余量，极端情况下可能爆仓
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss may be too small during high volatility sessions causing frequent stop outs
Lack of new bar check may cause repeated entries on the same bar
Consecutive false signals in ranging markets can accumulate losses
No margin check before opening positions, risk of margin call in extreme scenarios

It enters positions when short-term moving averages cross above long-term ones with confirming momentum signals, and exits on trend reversal or stop conditions. The EA incorporates trailing stops and risk management rules to protect capital.
